short: The naval battle off western Greece that left Octavian the only man standing, and made the empire possible.
full:
Actium was the end of a civil war that had been running, on and off, since Caesar crossed the Rubicon. Octavian's fleet under Agrippa blockaded Antony and Cleopatra in the Ambracian Gulf through the summer of 31 BCE, wearing down their crews with disease and desertion before either side committed to battle.

When Antony finally broke out on 2 September, the fighting was less a battle than an escape that partly succeeded. Cleopatra's squadron got clear and Antony followed; most of his fleet did not, and his land army surrendered within days. The pair reached Egypt but had nothing left to fight with, and both were dead within the year.

What made Actium decisive was not the ships lost but what it removed: after it there was no rival power centre, no second army, and nobody with a claim to set against Octavian's. Four years later he took the name Augustus.
